system.description:
Starting at 3rd level, your Doctrine guides you to learn special Flurry Techniques that supplement your Furious state while you are wielding a weapon from the Polearm or Flail groups or weapons with the Reach, Disarm or Deadly property

Okuri-Inu Fang. When you would deal [Weapon Damage] to a hostile creature, you can spend 2 Discipline to force all affected creatures to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, affected creatures become Shaken.

Okuri-Inu Fang – Shaken

The inflicting strike left your body with jitters and shakes from its impact. Shaken is treated as a Physical condition.

A Shaken creature can only make one attack on their turn.

A Shaken creature that casts a Jutsu on their turn as an Action increases its cost by 1 Flurry Die. This increases to 2 Flurry Die at 10th and 3 Flurry Die at 17th level.

This condition ends at the end of an affected creatures turn.

Hachiman’s Brutality. When you deal [Weapon Damage] to a hostile creature, you can spend 2 Discipline to force all affected creatures to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, affected creatures become Hobbled.

Koyanes Awareness. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 Discipline gaining 60ft of special sense called Fracture Sense. You become aware of all creatures in your sensory range with ranks of a Physical, Mental or Elemental condition until the end of your next turn.

Hachiman’s Brutality – Hobbled

The inflicting strike disabled your defense and agility making you a sitting duck. Hobbled is treated as a Physical condition.

A Hobbled creature cannot move further than 5 feet on their turn.

A Hobbled makes saving throws to resist being moved at disadvantage.

A Hobbled creature makes melee weapon and Taijutsu attacks at disadvantage.

This condition ends at the end of an affected creatures turn.
